notes.title: Birthday Update!
notes.content:
Today is reIterate()'s 2nd birthday
(It's also my 37th birthday, but we'll brush past that).

To celebrate, please welcome... SteamDeck Aspect Ratio Support!
On the pre-game menu, press 'LT' to toggle the aspect ratio to Deck and it'll fill the screen properly.
There's a few other little bits and pieces, and some achievements which I'm not entirely sure work properly, but we can figure that out later.

Happy Birthday to reIterate()! And, I suppose, to me too. I guess.
